title: Quantum Variational Approaches to the Maximum Independent Set Problem at Utility Scale
summary: Near-optimal solutions to Maximum Independent Set on dense graphs sit in local optima that greedy correction and maximality extension cannot escape. We encode near-optimal seeds as a uniform quantum superposition on ancilla qubits and evolve them under an excitation-preserving variational ansatz that holds the search inside the feasible Hamming-weight subspace. A preprocessing stage of spectral reordering and distance-based sparsification, together with history-guided post-processing of the sampled bitstrings, takes the method to 200 nodes.
